page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head across the top. Page number at top right. Epitaph set in capitals within the text. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: cula, & nobiscum tali vinculo retinere, quàm fine re ut fugiens à nobis coniungat se hostibus quos in Germania habemus, sicuti Vergerius fecit?[?]
Inter reliquas Epitaphia hoc de eo scriptum circumferebatur:

O. MARAE A MONTE, FORTE-FORTUNA PAPATUM, QUEM NEQ. IPSE QUIDEM SPERARE UNQUAM AUSUS FUIT, IN MAXIMA CARDINALIUM DISCORDIA CONSECUTO, QUOD SEX ANNIS PLUS CHRISTIANI SANGUINI FUDERIT QUAM ALIUS UNQUAM ANTICHRISTUS:

p.i: Fex sacrificulorum, grex Episcoporum, armentum Cardinalium, gratitudinis ergo monumentum æternum pos.

main_text.head: 168. MARCELLUS secundus.
main_text.p: MArcellus secundus, natione Hetruscus, Marcellus Ceruinus ante Papatum dictus, patriam habuit Montem Politianum in agro Florentino: episcopus primum Nicastrensis erat, postea Cardinalis tituli S. crucis in Hierusalem, ac tandem omnium Cardinalium in conclavi existentium consensu Pontifex creatus. Qui nono die Aprilis anni praedicti, nomen prius in baptismo susceptum mutare noluit, Mar

page.notes: Top-left line begins mid-word ("cula"), a fragment carried over from the previous page. "fine" in the first line is doubtful, marked [?]. "pos." at the end of the italic epitaph line is doubtful. Handwritten underlining and pen strokes over the lines are not printed text and are left out. Faint show-through from the reverse page is left out. Catchword "cellus" and signature "k 4" are at the foot.
